title: Search drawer: primary action has no visible label
detail: The footer action ("Search sample records") shows as a dark, square block with no readable text. It is a raw button.primary moved into the sheet footer, not a SentriUI.button.

title: Scan drawer: footer action and sample-tag button are unstyled
detail: "Find sample pig" is a dark, square block with no readable text, and "Use a sample tag" looks like plain text instead of a button. Both are raw buttons, not SentriUI.button.

title: Finding: "View Unit 7" looks like text, not a button

title: Where does Find a pig live: Home's Toolbox and Scan, or Pig list?
detail: The Pigs section text says search takes an ear tag or ear notch and scan reads the tag, and Pig list is a placeholder (old Figma: list, filter, detail). Home's prototype offers search and scan as its own drawers that open a task, not a pig record. Which one owns it, and does a result open the pig's record?
options: Home keeps Scan and Find; results open the pig record (Pig profile)
Pig list owns search; Home's Scan and Find open it
Both stay, Home as a shortcut into Pig list
recommendation: Home keeps the entrances; results open the Pig profile.

title: Is an Assistant answer applied to the record?
detail: The preview says "No live record was changed" and writes only to Records. The docs do not say whether a clarification updates the movement note, goes to a supervisor, or only closes the finding.
options: Applied to the record by the worker
Sent to a supervisor to apply
recommendation: Decide with the real agent design.
